lede: I’m Dhruv — a student engineer who turns raw signals into decisions. Video frames into crowd-risk zones, minute-level meter readings into bill forecasts, a few onboarding choices into movie recommendations.
workTitle: Projects with a problem at the centre
workIntro: Each one has a full case study: the problem, the architecture, the trade-offs, and what isn’t built yet.
